name: RDLS-SS-DWT+Pred
aliases: RDLS-SS-DWT+Pred — Hybrid Transform, Reversible Denoising Lifting Steps with Step Skipping and Prediction
Reversible Denoising Lifting Steps with Step Skipping and Prediction
definition: A hybrid transform that applies predictive coding to the final subbands of RDLS-SS-DWT to further reduce entropy, specifically effective when Null filters are used in RDLS-SS-DWT.
